name: SAMHSA National Helpline
notes: Free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral and information service in English and Spanish for mental and substance use disorders. TTY: 1-800-487-4889. Owning organization: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA).

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
notes: Free, confidential 24/7 support. Call, text, or chat. For Spanish, press 2 or text AYUDA. Veterans press 1. Owning organization: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline network (funded by SAMHSA).

name: Dallas County Health & Human Services (DCHHS) — Overdose Response & Naloxone Training
notes: Free community Narcan training that includes free naloxone. Monthly community trainings offered. Unconfirmed on the official page checked: exact training dates/times outside the monthly schedule, whether naloxone can be picked up outside a training session, and full office hours for walk-up.
